<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | Diagnose, then fix the narrowest seam the diagnosis names. parse_codex_footer stays the ONE definition of a Codex footer (plan 177); tighten it there, never add a second parser. Seat identity for a send is derived from the sender's own evidence (process, pane, harness session), the same way the other harnesses derive it; if that evidence is missing, refuse with a named error. Tests are built from real recorded captures under crates/harnesses/tests/fixtures/ (dated, pane-numbered, transcript stripped). Do not touch crates/tmux or the capture path: PR #73 rewrites it. |

| contracts | — |
